steps: Register for the First Florida member referral program and share your referral link with friends/family.
Friend registers via your link and becomes a First Florida Credit Union member.
Within 90 days of joining, friend sets up recurring direct deposit of $250+ into a new checking account or establishes a new loan.
You and your friend each receive a $50 Visa Reward Card 4-6 weeks after qualification (up to 10 referrals/$500 per year).
timing: Visa Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements completed (friend has 90 days from joining to qualify).
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Visa Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements completed (friend has 90 days from joining to qualify). — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The reward arrives as a physical card by mail (4-6 weeks); no expedite option exists in the terms — factor mail time into expectations.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
